title: Puerarin inhibits SiO(2)-induced pulmonary epithelial-mesenchymal transition via suppressing NF-kappaB activation: Insights from network pharmacology and experiment validation.
authors: Wen, Shengpeng; Wang, Kai; Wang, Qiushi; Liu, Zhihong
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学、分子对接和MD研究葛根素与NF-kappaB1蛋白结合并抑制矽肺纤维化，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接而非TF-DNA互作，且方法可迁移性有限，故评分较低。
abstract: Silicosis is a progressive and irreversible occupational pulmonary fibrotic disease for which no clinically available agents can effectively reverse established fibrosis. Puerarin (PUE), a natural isoflavonoid, has previously been demonstrated to exert protective effects against silicosis; however, its underlying protective mechanisms remain poorly understood. In the present study, we integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and in vitro experiments to elucidate the therapeutic targets and mechanisms of PUE against SiO(2)-induced pulmonary fibrosis. Network pharmacological analysis identified 227 potential targets of PUE for silicosis treatment. The IL-17 signaling pathway emerged as the most significantly enriched pathway, with core targets including IL6, TNF, AKT1, IL1B, ALB, EGFR, CASP3, MMP9, NF-kappaB1, and MAPK3. Molecular docking revealed that PUE exhibited the lowest binding energy with NF-kappaB1, and molecular dynamics simulations further confirmed a stable binding affinity between PUE and NF-kappaB1. In the SiO(2)-induced BEAS-2B cell model, PUE treatment markedly inhibited NF-kappaB p65 phosphorylation, downregulated the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6, and reversed epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT). Collectively, this study provides experimental evidence that the anti-fibrotic effect of PUE may be mediated by binding to NF-kappaB1, thereby inhibiting NF-kappaB signaling activation, attenuating SiO(2)-induced EMT, and suppressing inflammatory responses. These findings lay a theoretical foundation for the further development of PUE as a potential therapeutic agent for silicosis.
abstract_zh: 矽肺是一种进行性且不可逆的职业性肺纤维化疾病，目前临床上尚无药物能有效逆转已形成的纤维化。葛根素（PUE），一种天然异黄酮类化合物，先前已被证明对矽肺具有保护作用；然而，其潜在的保护机制仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们整合了网络药理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和体外实验，以阐明PUE对抗SiO(2)诱导的肺纤维化的治疗靶点和机制。网络药理学分析确定了PUE治疗矽肺的227个潜在靶点。IL-17信号通路成为富集最显著的通路，核心靶点包括IL6、TNF、AKT1、IL1B、ALB、EGFR、CASP3、MMP9、NF-kappaB1和MAPK3。分子对接显示，PUE与NF-kappaB1的结合能最低，分子动力学模拟进一步证实了PUE与NF-kappaB1之间稳定的结合亲和力。在SiO(2)诱导的BEAS-2B细胞模型中，PUE处理显著抑制了NF-kappaB p65磷酸化，下调了促炎细胞因子（包括TNF-alpha、IL-1beta和IL-6）的表达，并逆转了上皮-间质转化（EMT）。总体而言，本研究提供了实验证据，表明PUE的抗纤维化作用可能通过结合NF-kappaB1介导，从而抑制NF-kappaB信号激活、减弱SiO(2)诱导的EMT并抑制炎症反应。这些发现为PUE作为矽肺潜在治疗药物的进一步开发奠定了理论基础。
